en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammānuloma (1), Dukatikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (3) 3.12.
Kilesagocchaka, Kusala-ttika (The Group on Defilements, the Triplet of the Wholesome)
3.12.1. The Pair on Defilements (Kilesaduka), the Triplet on the Wholesome (Kusalattika).
Dependent on a wholesome state that is not a defilement, there arises a wholesome state that is not a defilement, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of root condition: one; in the case of object condition: one ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance condition:
one. (Abbreviated. (In the co-nascent section ... pe ... and in the inquiry section, it is one in every instance.
Dependent on a defiled unwholesome state, a defiled unwholesome state arises by way of root condition ... three.
Dependent on a non-defiled unwholesome state, a non-defiled unwholesome state arises by way of root condition … three.

Dependent on both a defiled unwholesome state and a non-defiled unwholesome state, a defiled unwholesome state arises by way of root condition … three. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are nine;
under object condition there are nine (nine in all cases); under non-disappearance condition there are nine. (Abbreviated.)

Dependent on a defiled unwholesome state, a defiled unwholesome state arises by way of the not-root condition: dependent on doubt, delusion accompanied by doubt arises; dependent on restlessness, delusion accompanied by restlessness arises.

Dependent on a non-defiled unwholesome state, a defiled unwholesome state arises by way of the not-root condition: dependent on the aggregates accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness, delusion accompanied by doubt and accompanied by restlessness arises.
Dependent on a defiled unwholesome state and a non-defiled unwholesome state, a defiled unwholesome state arises by way of the not-root condition:
dependent on the aggregates associated with doubt and doubt itself, delusion associated with doubt arises;
dependent on the aggregates associated with restlessness and restlessness itself, delusion associated with restlessness arises. (Abbreviated.)

With respect to not-root: three; with respect to not-predominance: nine; with respect to not-prenascence: nine; with respect to not-postnascence: nine; with respect to not-repetition: nine; with respect to not-kamma: three; with respect to not-resultant: nine; with respect to not-dissociation: nine. (Abbreviated; the sections on conascence, etc., should be expanded.
An unwholesome state that is a defilement is a condition, by way of the root-condition, for an unwholesome state that is a defilement.

(Abbreviated. With respect to root: three; with respect to object: nine; with respect to predominance: nine (three in the middle [conascent-predominance]); with respect to proximity... [and so forth].

Nine, by way of immediate condition nine ... [and so on] ... by way of decisive support nine, by way of repetition nine, by way of kamma three, by way of nutriment three, by way of faculty three, by way of jhāna three, by way of path nine, by way of association nine ... [and so on] ... by way of non-disappearance nine. (Abbreviated.
Dependent on a state that is neither-defiled-nor-indeterminate and indeterminate, a state that is neither-defiled-nor-indeterminate and indeterminate arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, one; in the case of the object condition, one … pe … in the case of the non-disappearance condition, one. (Abbreviated.
(In the section on co-nascence as well … pe … in the section on questions as well, it is one in every instance. 3.12.2.
Saṅkilesikaduka, Question Section.
Dependent on a wholesome state that is subject to defilement, a wholesome state subject to defilement arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a wholesome state not subject to defilement, a wholesome state not subject to defilement arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of root condition, there are two; in the case of object condition, there are two ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance condition, there are two.
Dependent on a defiled unwholesome state, a defiled unwholesome state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. In the case of root condition, there is one;
in the case of object condition, there is one ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance condition, there is one. (Abbreviated.)
(In the section on co-nascence as well …pe… and in the section on inquiry as well, it is the same for all cases.
Dependent on a defiled indeterminate state, a defiled indeterminate state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-defiled indeterminate state, a non-defiled indeterminate state arises by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on a defiled indeterminate state and a non-defiled indeterminate state, a defiled indeterminate state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Under root condition there are five; under object condition there are two …pe… under non-disappearance condition there are five.
3.12.3. The Defiled Dyad, The Wholesome Triad.
3.12.3.1–7. Section on Dependent Origination, etc. (Paṭiccādivāra).
The Tetrad of Conditions (Paccayacatukka):
Dependent upon an undefiled wholesome state, an undefiled wholesome state arises by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*). (Abbreviated.)
In the root condition, one; in the object condition, one … pe … in the non-disappearance condition, one. (Abbreviated.
[The same applies] in the section on co-nascence … pe … and in the section on inquiry, in all cases, one.
Dependent on a defiled unwholesome state, a defiled unwholesome state arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the root condition, one; in the object condition, one … pe … in the non-disappearance condition, one. (Abbreviated.
[The same applies] everywhere in the co-nascent section … pe … and in the inquiry section.
Dependent on a not-defiled indeterminate state, a not-defiled indeterminate state arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, one; in the case of the object condition, one … pe … in the case of the non-disappearance condition, one. (Abbreviated.
[The same applies] in the section on co-nascence … pe … and in the section on inquiry, in all cases, one. 3.12.4.
The Dyad of Association with Defilements, the Triad of the Wholesome.
3.12.4.1–7. Section on Dependent Origination, etc. (Paṭiccādivāra).
The Tetrad of Conditions (Paccayacatukka):
Dependent on a wholesome state dissociated from the defilements (kilesa), a wholesome state dissociated from the defilements arises by way of the root-condition (hetupaccaya). (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, one; in the case of the object condition, one … pe … in the case of the non-disappearance condition, one. (Abbreviated.
[The same applies] in the co-nascence section … pe … and in all instances of the inquiry section, it is one.
Dependent on an unwholesome state associated with defilements, an unwholesome state associated with defilements arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, one; in the case of the object condition, one … pe … in the case of the non-disappearance condition, one. (Abbreviated.
[The same applies] in the section on co-nascence … pe … and in the section on inquiry, in all instances, one.
Dependent on a state that is dissociated from defilements and indeterminate, there arises a state dissociated from defilements and indeterminate by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.)
Under the root condition, one; under the object condition, one …pe… under the non-disappearance condition, one. (Abbreviated.
(In the section on co-nascence as well …pe… in the section on inquiry as well, it is one in every instance.
3.12.5. The Dyads on Defilement and Defiled, and the Tetrads on the Wholesome.
3.12.5.1–7. Section on Dependent Origination, etc. (Paṭiccādivāra).
The Tetrad of Conditions.

Dependent upon a wholesome state that is both defiled and not itself a defilement, there arises a wholesome state that is both defiled and not itself a defilement, by way of the root-condition. (Abbreviated.)
Under the root condition, one; under the object condition, one … pe … under the non-disappearance condition, one. (Abbreviated.
(In the “Conascent” section … pe … and in the “Investigation” section, it is one in every instance.

Dependent on a state that is both a defilement and subject to defilement and is unwholesome, there arises a state that is both a defilement and subject to defilement and is unwholesome, by way of the root condition … three.

Dependent on a state that is both subject to defilement and not itself a defilement, and is unwholesome, there arises a state that is both subject to defilement and not itself a defilement, and is unwholesome, by way of root condition... [three].

Dependent on a state that is both a defilement and subject to defilement, and is unwholesome, and a state that is both subject to defilement and not itself a defilement, and is unwholesome, there arises a state that is both a defilement and subject to defilement, and is unwholesome, by way of root condition... [three]. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of root condition, nine; in the case of object condition, nine ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance condition, nine. (Abbreviated; similar to the unwholesome in the "Defilement" dyad. This should be expanded everywhere in the "Conascent" section ... pe ... and in the "Investigation" section as well.

Dependent on a state that is both subject to defilement and not itself a defilement, and is indeterminate, there arises a state that is both subject to defilement and not itself a defilement, and is indeterminate, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. In the case of root condition, one; in the case of object condition, one ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance condition, one. (Abbreviated.)
(In the section on Co-nascence as well …pe… and in the section on Questions as well, it is the same for all cases. 3.12.6.
The Dyad of Defiled by Defilements, The Triplet of the Wholesome.
3.12.6.1–7. The Section on Dependent, etc. (Paṭiccādivāra).
The Tetrad of Conditions:
Dependent on a defiled and afflicted unwholesome state, there arises a defiled and afflicted unwholesome state by way of root condition... three.
Dependent on an afflicted but not defiled unwholesome state, there arises an afflicted but not defiled unwholesome state by way of root condition... three.

Dependent on a state that is both a defilement and corrupt, and also unwholesome and corrupt, there arises a state that is both a defilement and corrupt, and also unwholesome and corrupt, by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*). … [Three] (Abbreviated).
Under root-condition there are nine; under object-condition there are nine … pe … under non-disappearance-condition there are nine.
3.12.7. The Defilement-Defilement-Associated Pair; The Wholesome Triplet.
3.12.7.1–7. Section on Dependent Origination (Paṭiccādivāra).
The Tetrad of Conditions (Paccayacatukka):

Dependent upon a state that is both a defilement and associated with defilements and is unwholesome, there arises a state that is both a defilement and associated with defilements and is unwholesome, by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*)—three [answers].

Dependent on an unwholesome state that is associated with defilements but is not itself a defilement, there arises an unwholesome state associated with defilements but not itself a defilement, by way of root condition. … [three] … Dependent on a state that is both a defilement and associated with defilements and is unwholesome,
and dependent on a state that is associated with defilements but not itself a defilement and is unwholesome,
there arises a state that is both a defilement and associated with defilements and is unwholesome, by way of root condition.
… three. (Abbreviated.
Nine in the case of root; nine in the case of object …pe… nine in the case of non-disappearance.
3.12.8. The Dyad of the Defiled but Dissociated from Defilements; the Triad of the Wholesome.
3.12.8.1–7. Section on Dependent Origination (Paṭiccasamuppādavāra).
The Tetrad of Conditions (Paccayacatukka):

Dependent upon a wholesome state that is dissociated from the defilements but subject to defilement, there arises a wholesome state dissociated from the defilements but subject to defilement, by way of the root-condition (hetupaccaya).

Dependent on a wholesome state dissociated from defilements and not subject to corruption, there arises a wholesome state dissociated from defilements and not subject to corruption by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
There are two [conditions] for roots, two for objects … pe … two for non-disappearance.

Dependent on an indeterminate state dissociated from defilements but subject to corruption, there arises an indeterminate state dissociated from defilements but subject to corruption by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is dissociated from the defilements, non-defiled, and indeterminate, there arises a state that is dissociated from the defilements, non-defiled, and indeterminate, by way of root condition. … three.

Dependent on a state that is dissociated from the defilements, defiled, and indeterminate, and a state that is dissociated from the defilements, non-defiled, and indeterminate, there arises a state that is dissociated from the defilements, defiled, and indeterminate, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the root condition, five; in the object condition, two ... [and so on] ... in the repetition condition, one ... [and so on] ... in the non-disappearance condition, five.
The Wholesome Triplet of the Defilement Group is finished.
